note: A folder named gen or generated above the project root must not cause small JSON data files inside the project to be demoted as generated data. DataFileClassifier and is_data_file now take the project root and decide the generated shape with the shared inspect helper relative_shape_is_generated, which looks only at the part of the path inside the root (and also matches Windows root spellings that differ, as inspect does). Corpus paths have no gen ancestor, so all ranked rows remain byte-identical to the committed reference.
